maddeler.e:
تشتهوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَهُوا (taštahū) /taʃ.ta.huː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
# تُشْتَهَوْا (tuštahaw) /tuʃ.ta.haw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَهَى (ištahā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
